question.title: Research question
question.description: The main research question or topic to investigate.
question.default: Find 10 AI code assistant tools and summarize them.

searchQueries.title: Search queries (optional)
searchQueries.description: Custom search queries; defaults to [question] if empty.

maxResults.title: Max final results
maxResults.description: Maximum number of research items to extract and return.

maxSearchResultsPerQuery.title: Max Google search results per query
maxSearchResultsPerQuery.description: Maximum number of search results to fetch per search query.

useApifyScrapers.title: Use Apify web scrapers
useApifyScrapers.description: Enable Apify scrapers to fetch real web content. If false, uses LLM-only mode.

geminiModel.title: Gemini model
geminiModel.description: The Google Gemini model to use for content generation and analysis.

geminiApiKey.title: Gemini API key
geminiApiKey.description: Your Google Gemini API key. Can also be set via GEMINI_API_KEY environment variable.
